I rate this clinic five stars in a 360° manner. From the first appointment, an emergency with Dr. Viviane, she helped with the emergency and also discovered other issues with my kitten that needed attention – things that other places I had gone to hadn't noticed. Since the emergency involved an ophthalmologist, Dr. Viviane referred me to Dr. Juliana, who subsequently carefully evaluated my kitten and prescribed the appropriate medication for his condition (he is blind in one eye). The most important issue ended up not being the eye problem, but his teeth. I scheduled an appointment with Dr. Igor, another professional I have nothing but praise for. Initially, he suggested brushing and medication, but these weren't enough for Mingau. He needed to have his teeth surgically removed, and I was distressed just thinking about him on an operating table. But I received all the necessary information and remained calm. In the pre-operative assessment, Mingau needed to have heart exams (surgical risk assessment). He was also very well received by Dr. Acauã, who was very patient and caring. During and after the surgery, I was reassured by the anesthesiologist Danielle, who sent me the cutest photo in the world (I'll leave it here in the review). Everything went well in his surgery, he came home, but ended up having swelling in the paw where the IV was and I quickly returned with him. Dr. Lara attended to him in the emergency room and I only have praise for her, once again. I tried to summarize, I don't know if I left out any professional, but I wanted to leave this record with the same care they had for my Mingauzinho. Thank you ❤️

Simply wonderful. My 4 cats' vet, Dr. Lara, is marvelous. She loves what she does, going beyond what she sees. She treats the animals with respect, love, and care. The entire team's service is top-notch. I wouldn't trade this family for anything. I'm absolutely certain that my kittens are safe and well cared for there. I highly recommend them!!!!! Gratitude to the entire team that runs the clinic with so much love.

My cat died there. She arrived on Monday for an ultrasound, the doctor said she had a very large hairball in her esophagus or stomach and she HAD TO EXPEL IT. She sent her home. Thursday morning the cat went into critical condition because the hairball had descended and become stuck in her intestine. Emergency surgery on the intestine. Is this or is this not negligence?
At discharge: the doctor tells her not to jump on a high bed, but to let her walk freely, it's better.
Stitches break. Doctor says she moved too much. The cat's fault and ours. That SHE SHOULD HAVE STAYED 10 DAYS INSIDE THE SHOWER ENCLOSURE! That was in the discharge document. Where???? Show me the following phrase: movement restriction.
Second surgery, the cat dies.
Total cost 12 thousand and the cat is dead.
You should understand each other: is she supposed to walk freely or is she supposed to have restrictions or is she supposed to stay in the shower enclosure? Is she supposed to expel the large hairball at home??? Or were they supposed to remove it endoscopically without any incision??? What kind of doctors are these? And that ultrasound technician??? Nobody understands each other and the cat died. I'm devastated when I hear about a similar case with a ball of duct tape where IEMEV doesn't even let the cat go home. They admit her and remove it through her mouth. I regret not taking her to IEMEV. That ultrasound technician at Cigavet was cold and uncommitted, just like the others. My cat's suffering with 2 intestinal surgeries in 4 days was barbaric. It still hurts today and we will never forget.
The service is excellent and the veterinarians are very attentive.

It's been 11 days since my cat Serena passed away. We are still grieving and miss her terribly. She was admitted to Cigavet as an emergency patient and was received by Dr. Lara. She was very ill but was very well cared for by everyone at the clinic. It's a clean place, the hospitalization is organized, and they show special affection for the animals. I want to express my gratitude to everyone, especially Dr. Lara and Dr. Bruno, who made all the difference during those two days of hospitalization. They were very professional and respectful towards Serena and me. Cigavet is a different kind of clinic that truly cares for your pet, even after they're gone. I highly recommend them. Thank you.
It's a great veterinary clinic. The staff at Cigavet have always treated our pet very well, with great professionalism and care. I recommend them.

I also want to highlight the professional who performed the ultrasound (unfortunately, I don't remember her name). She was very kind, competent, and patient. She explained the exam clearly and cared for Teca with great affection.

For Dr. Bárbara: Our first consultation with Dr. Bárbara was a wonderful experience meeting her! As a chihuahua mom herself, she knew how to handle him very well. She is so sweet, kind, and gentle. He felt so welcomed! He wasn't stressed or agitated. I recommend her for endocrine care!

For Dr. Lara: Dr. Lara, besides being an excellent veterinarian, is very humane and dedicated to her patients! I often say: it's a successful marriage. Of course, successful doesn't mean perfect; because nobody is. What impresses me about her? She embodies the veterinary profession. She lives (and loves) what she set out to be and what she trained for. She gives her all. Even when she can't be directly with him, she's always nearby; because she knows how important her presence is to my pet. I've had 6 pets and now I have 4; She shows the same dedication and excellent service to all 6 children as she does to all 4. I always leave there with all my questions answered. I recommend the Cigavet veterinary clinic and Dr. Lara!
